title: 第十三章 暗影神殿第十四章 地脉
lines: 天色渐暗，长孙岳沿着城西的小路往回走。
他没有走大路。大路上行人多，巡逻的卫兵多，容易留下痕迹。他走的是城西的旧巷——狭窄、曲折、很少有人走，两边是斑驳的墙壁和紧闭的木门，偶尔有一只野猫从墙头跳过，在暮色中留下一道黑影。
小白虎蹲在他肩头，金色的眼睛警惕地扫视着四周。
走了约莫一炷香的功夫，长孙岳停下了脚步。
巷子的尽头，站着一个人。
那人穿着一身灰白色的长袍，负手而立，像在等人。暮色从他身后涌来，将他的影子拉得很长很长，长到像一条从地底伸出的手臂。
月光还没有升起，但那人站在那里，周身没有任何光亮，却让人一眼就能看见他——不是因为显眼，而是因为他太“空”了。他站在那里，却像不存在一样，没有气息，没有灵力波动，连心跳声都听不见。
小白虎猛地弓起脊背，喉咙里发出低沉的吼声，金色的眼睛死死盯着那个人。
长孙岳感觉不到他的修为。
不是隐藏，不是收敛，而是——他根本感觉不到。那个人像一口枯井，又像一片深渊，你往里面扔石头，永远听不见回响。
那人转过身来。
月光终于越过了墙头，照在他脸上——那是一张普通的、毫无特征的脸，像用泥巴捏出来的，没有表情，没有温度。五官端正但毫无记忆点，扔进人群里转眼就会忘记。但他的眼睛是灰白色的，像蒙了一层雾，又像两颗被磨砂的玻璃珠，倒映着月光，却没有光。
“长孙岳。”他说。
不是疑问，是陈述。声音平淡得像在说今天天气不错，但每个字都像从极深的地底传来，带着一种让人脊背发凉的笃定。
长孙岳的手暗中掐诀，灵力在经脉中运转。
“你是谁？在背后盯着我的人是你？”
“暗影神殿。”那人说，“你可以叫我‘影七’。”
暗影神殿。
长孙岳的瞳孔微微一缩。修士联盟的死敌，由亡命之徒、叛教修士、邪修组成，喜好抢夺他人神血本源、吞噬天赋神通增进修为，战力强横，被全天下追杀，隐于黑暗，伺机而动。
“暗影神殿的人，胆敢在洛阳城现身？”长孙岳的语气平静，但每个字都带着刀锋，“你不怕死？”
“怕。”影七说，“但你比死更有价值。”
“你找我做什么？”
“邀请。加入暗影神殿。”
长孙岳沉默了一瞬，然后轻轻笑了一下。那笑容很淡，带着一种居高临下的审视，像在看一个不自量力的蝼蚁。
“暗影神殿？”他说，“一群躲在阴沟里的老鼠，也配邀请我？”
影七没有动怒。他的表情没有任何变化，像一张面具。
“修士联盟的光明正大，你见识过了。”他说，“十二年前，你们长孙家被灭门时，联盟做了什么？没有援救。而真正阻止救援的，恰恰是联盟的太上长老玄清子。”
长孙岳的笑容消失了，但眼中的寒意更盛。
“你想说什么？”
“我想说，天下乌鸦一般黑。”影七说，“修士联盟不是好东西，暗影神殿也不是。但至少暗影神殿不装——我们坏在明处，他们坏在暗处。你选哪边？”
“我都不选。”长孙岳说，“我不需要你们。”
“你确定？”
“确定。”
影七沉默了片刻，然后轻轻叹了口气。
“可惜了。真龙血脉，千年难遇。”
content_en:
As the sky grew dark, Changsun Yue walked back along the path to the west of the city.
He didn't take the high road. There are many pedestrians on the road and many guards patrolling, so it is easy to leave traces. He was walking along the old alley in the west of the city - narrow, winding, rarely used by people, with mottled walls and closed wooden doors on both sides. Occasionally, a wild cat would jump over the wall, leaving a dark shadow in the dusk.
The little white tiger squatted on his shoulder, its golden eyes scanning the surroundings vigilantly.
After walking for about a stick of incense, Changsun Yue stopped.
At the end of the alley, there was a man standing.
The man was wearing a gray-white robe and stood with his hands behind his back, as if waiting for someone. Dusk came from behind him, stretching his shadow very long, until it looked like an arm stretching out from the ground.
The moonlight has not yet risen, but the man is standing there, without any light around him, yet people can see him at a glance - not because he is conspicuous, but because he is too "empty". He stood there as if he didn't exist, with no breath, no spiritual energy fluctuations, and even the sound of his heartbeat could not be heard.
The little white tiger arched his back suddenly, roaring deeply in his throat, and stared at the man with his golden eyes.
Changsun Yue couldn't feel his cultivation.
It's not hiding or restraining, but - he can't feel it at all. That person is like a dry well or an abyss. If you throw stones into it, you will never hear the response.
The man turned around.
The moonlight finally crossed the wall and shone on his face - it was an ordinary, featureless face, as if it was made of mud, with no expression or warmth. He has good facial features but no memory points. If he is thrown into a crowd, he will be forgotten in a blink of an eye. But his eyes were gray-white, like a layer of fog, and like two frosted glass beads, reflecting the moonlight, but there was no light.
"Changsun Yue," he said.
It's not a question, it's a statement. The voice was as calm as saying that the weather is nice today, but every word seemed to come from the deep underground, with a spine-chilling certainty.
Changsun Yue's hands secretly kneaded the secret, and his spiritual power circulated in his meridians.
"Who are you? Are you the one staring at me from behind?"
"Shadow Temple." The man said, "You can call me 'Shadow Seven'."
Shadow Temple.
Changsun Yue's pupils shrank slightly. The sworn enemies of the Monk Alliance are composed of desperadoes, renegade monks, and evil cultivators. They like to steal the source of divine blood from others and devour their natural talents to enhance their cultivation. They are powerful in combat and are hunted by the whole world. They hide in the darkness and wait for opportunities.
"People from the Shadow Temple dare to show up in Luoyang City?" Changsun Yue's tone was calm, but every word was laced with a razor edge, "Aren't you afraid of death?"
"Afraid." Ying Qi said, "But you are more valuable than death."
"What do you want from me?"
"Invitation. Join the Shadow Temple."
Changsun Yue was silent for a moment, and then smiled softly. The smile was very light, with a condescending look, like looking at an ant who was overestimating his abilities.
"Shadow Temple?" he said, "A bunch of rats hiding in the gutter are worthy of inviting me?"
Ying Qi was not angry. His expression remained unchanged, like a mask.
"You have seen how upright the Monks Alliance is," he said. "Twelve years ago, when your eldest grandson's family was wiped out, what did the Alliance do? There was no rescue. And the one who really prevented the rescue was none other than the Supreme Elder Xuan Qingzi of the Alliance."
Changsun Yue's smile disappeared, but the chill in his eyes grew stronger.
"What do you want to say?"
"I want to say that the world is as dark as crows." Shadow Seven said, "The Monk Alliance is not a good thing, and neither is the Shadow Temple. But at least the Shadow Temple is not pretending - we are bad in the open, and they are bad in the dark. Which side do you choose?"
"I don't even choose." Changsun Yue said, "I don't need you."
"Are you sure?"
"OK."
Ying Qi was silent for a moment, then sighed softly.
"It's a pity. True dragon bloodline is rare to find in a thousand years."
